relations.subject: Dorji Wangchuk
relations.evidence: Dorji Wangchuk majored in both Classical Indology and Tibetology at the University of Hamburg, graduating with a Masters of Arts in 2002.

relations.subject: Dorji Wangchuk
relations.evidence: He wrote his doctoral dissertation on "The Resolve to Become a Buddha: A Study of the Bodhicitta Concept in Indo-Tibetan Buddhism" and received his PhD from the same university in 2005.

relations.subject: Dorji Wangchuk
relations.evidence: Since 1998, he has been teaching and researching at the University of Hamburg in various capacities.

relations.subject: Dorji Wangchuk
relations.evidence: He also taught a term each at the University of Copenhagen, McGill University, and Renmin University of China.
